spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (जपति)
1 To speak, to say or tell.
2 To meditate, to speak internally, to say to one's self.
With उप prefixed,
To divide.

m. (-पः)
Muttering prayers, repeating inaudibly passages from the scriptures, charms, names of a deity, counting silently the beads of a rosary, &c.
f. (-पा)
The China rose, the flower or plant; also जवा.
E.
जप to repeat inaudibly, affix अप्; the flower is a sacred object.

m. (-पः)
Muttering prayers or beads, reciting passages of the Vedas, &c. inaudibly.
E.
जप to mutter, &c. affix घञ्, deriv. irr.

n. (-नं)
Inaudible repetition of prayers, &c.: see the last.
E.
जप as before, affix ल्युट्.

n. (-नं)
1 Declining, rejection, dissent.
2 Dismissing, completing, finishing.
E.
जप to speak, causal form, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be meditated on, to be repeated inaudibly.
E.
जप, and अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Devoted to religious meditation, engaged in muttering prayers, &c.
E.
जप as above, and परायण adhering or attached to.

f. (-ला)
A rosary.
E.
जप, and माला a string of beads, &c.

m. (-ज्ञः)
Muttering prayers as a religious rite or sacrifice.
E.
जप, and यज्ञ sacrifice.

ind.
Having repeated inaudibly.
E.
जप, and क्त्वा affix, इट inserted.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Repeated inaudibly.
E.
जप to mutter prayers, and क्त aff.

ind.
Having repeated inaudibly.
E.
जप, and क्त्वा affix: see जपित्वा; the omission of इट् is unusual.

mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं)
To be repeated inaudibly, to be said over repeatedly, (a prayer, &c.)
E.
जप, and यत् aff.

mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं)
To be muttered, &c.
n. (-प्यं)
The muttering of prayers, &c.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Muttering prayers, one who does so.
E.
जप, and ण्वुल् aff.
